_comment: Contract for the signed plan block and the public offer (ShipGuard 0.13). Source of truth for CLI code, server code and tests; the output spec wins on wording. Signed with the EXISTING bundle key: typ separates bundle, account and offer. No new key role, no second signing key. Test vectors: plan-v2.vectors.json.
verifyOrder: strict header parse, only alg, kid, typ
alg is EdDSA and typ is exact for the document kind
kid resolved from the pinned keyring with role bundle
signature over the exact header.payload bytes
account document: acct equals the signed-in account
live reply: nonce equals the sent nonce and binding.scanId equals this scan's id
cached copy only: iat <= now + 5 min, now < exp, exp - iat <= 72 h (offer: <= 7 days)

onFailure.effect: plan data discarded, plain Free, scan exit code unchanged, never Pro, never a crash

optional.refreshAfter: integer seconds the CLI may skip a call (CLI clamps)
optional.nonce: string, 22 base64url chars, echo of X-ShipGuard-Nonce
optional.label: string, plan display name in the server's words
optional.account: { status: active|trialing|pending|past_due|ending|lapsed|none (unknown kept as unsupported), text: string }
optional.usage: { percent: integer 0-100, state: ok|warn|used (unknown = ok), resetsAt: ISO time, text: string, counted: boolean|null }
optional.proAdds: { planName: string, rules: integer|null, stacks: string[], areas: string[] }
optional.offer: { text: string, slot: string from the CLI's closed go-link list }
optional.updateNotice: string (cap 200) or null; the server compares the client version from the hello

account.note: Everything except the required keys is optional; missing = not shown. Unknown fields are ignored. Server builds the payload from an exact key allowlist (no email, ids, flags, other plan names).

optional.counts: { '<stack>': { rules: integer, areas: string[] } }, per-stack Pro rule counts (file format owned by W9)

offer.note: Public, no auth, no acct, no nonce. Request carries stack names only (or none for the generic offer).

clientHello.nonceHeader: X-ShipGuard-Nonce: 22 base64url chars, on Bearer calls
